description.value:
Slot none; Price 10,000 gp (lesser), 20,000 gp (normal), 40,000 gp (greater)
Weight 5 lbs.; Feat Cost 2 sp

An umbral talent gains the darkness descriptor. As long as the talent is in effect, the creature or object affected radiates darkness in a 10-foot radius, reducing illumination similar to the effects of the basic effect of the Dark sphere. Nonmagical sources of light, such as torches or lanterns, do not increase the light level in this area.

Magical light sources only increase the light level in an area affected by an umbral talent if they are of a higher level than the umbral talent’s caster level. This effect does not stack with itself or with any other effect that creates darkness.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Umbral Spell; Cost 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Apply as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect of caster level seven or lower. Hold this apparatus in at least one hand while applying it. Spend one of three daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. Its feat's extra spell-point and casting-time costs are waived, but normal effect and other-metamagic costs still apply.

The talent gains darkness and the affected creature or object radiates a ten-foot darkness area while the talent lasts. Nonmagical light cannot brighten it; magical light must exceed its caster level. This darkness does not stack with itself or other darkness. Scene illumination and token auras require deliberate resolution.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. Feat Cost applies to taking the feat, not using the physical apparatus.
